steps.name: Colors of Emotion (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Minuet] in 「Adrica」, then defeat [Requiem] in 「Divine Tree Lapier」 to obtain the <Purple Hourglass>. Return to [Minuet] and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: You're here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, is everything all right?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: You needn't worry now. Ever since you returned from Pneuma, %s, even Lady Gaia's concern for Lady Iris... Everything is all right now.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Pneuma's energy isn't evil, but we didn't know how it might affect beings directly exposed to it.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: It's all right now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad. Then I'll be going...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Didn't you come because you had something to say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just wanted to see how you were doing.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: This time, I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it...?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: There's something you brought back from Pneuma, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Something that should have remained in Pneuma seems to have come here with you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't remember bringing anything. Iris would have told me if I had...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Pneuma retains the ancient gods' energy... Lady Iris may not have sensed it. She will know now.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: If it falls into the hands of those who reject the gods, it could be misused. Would you retrieve it for me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I brought it here, I'll find it.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: It should be safe with me. I can keep its power from affecting this place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What exactly am I looking for?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Hourglasses... Hourglasses of different colors, each holding different emotions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: They're different from the hourglasses you saw in Pneuma. I don't know why they came... But please retrieve them. It would take me a long time to find them.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: They likely drifted toward places where great power lingered... Find the first, and it should help you find the next.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: One is close to here...
(Minuet quietly looks toward Lapier.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I sense the feeling of purification...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go right away.

lines.speaker: 미네에트
lines.text: Please do...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm back, Minuet.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Was it difficult to find?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The purple sand was sparkling, so I found it easily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It isn't an ordinary object, is it?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: No.
(Minuet accepts the purple hourglass from %s.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Unrefined energy from Pneuma... It isn't evil, but it does not belong here.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: The purple sand holds the feeling of purification, the wish for a clean body and mind.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: A feeling the ancient gods wished for the world.
(As Minuet closes her eyes, the purple sand stirs inside the hourglass, then gradually disappears.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Lady Gaia would wish this hourglass to be used this way. Lady Iris will feel these emotions too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: You're welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where should I look for the others?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: That... I don't really know either!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I could sense this one because it was nearby.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: But I can't leave Adrica, so...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We hardly have any clues. Where should I go...?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Then I'll tell you about the feelings within the hourglasses...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Passion and love, prosperity and vitality, happiness, hope and peace, stability and harmony, and care for another.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Look for places suited to those six remaining feelings...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a little vague... But stability and harmony bring someone to mind. Harmonia...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Please do...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: You needn't bring that hourglass back to me. Harmonia will deal with it in her own way.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: ...Lady Gaia will guide you. Don't worry too much.
(Minuet gives a faint smile. Her face still seems almost expressionless, yet you sense a quiet joy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go and look there.

steps.name: Colors of Emotion (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Evil Order] in 「Frozen World」 and obtain the <Blue Hourglass>. Then turn in the quest to [Harmonia] in 「Old Belos」.

lines.text: (Harmonia looks a little startled at %s's arrival.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Harmonia. Why are you so surprised?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: It's been a while. I'm sorry to greet you with such a startled look.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: You're clearly the adventurer, but I sense energy from somewhere else. Somewhere full of spirits, apart from here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, so that's why. Here's what happened...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain the hourglasses to Harmonia.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Ah... You've been to Pneuma. That explains it. Something has felt strange here.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: The spirits were preparing to move elsewhere when they became unsettled. So that was why.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Hmm...
(Holding her necklace, Harmonia quietly looks at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: An hourglass from there seems to have fallen somewhere with a cold energy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, the Frozen World...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: With it, the ancient gods' wishes for harmony and stability can be conveyed directly to Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: It's not an object a spirit can handle carelessly. Please bring it to me, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: All right... Take care.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Did your trip go well, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I found it without much trouble.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is something happening here?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: May I have the hourglass first?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, of course. Huh?
(Harmonia extends the right hand holding her necklace. The hourglass slowly rises from %s's hand.)
(At Harmonia's gesture, the glass cracks. Blue sand spills through the fissures and scatters away.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: These are the feelings of stability and harmony wished for in Pneuma...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: The gods must have looked upon spirits and living beings with such feelings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pneuma...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you mentioned that the spirits are moving elsewhere. Is something happening to the Inner World?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Nothing serious. Lady Iris' Inner World will gradually become smaller now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Lady Iris has taken her place as God of the Astral Realm, so there is less reason to maintain this place.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: And Evil Order is gone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see... I understand.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Geis and I are sending the spirits here to other places. As this place gradually disappears, we will have to leave too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where will the spirits go?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Who can say...? Each will naturally be drawn to a place where they are needed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Where should I look for the remaining hourglasses...?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: The hourglasses that drifted into Adrica and Lady Iris' Inner World seem to have followed the spirits' energy.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: ...You'll have to go outside to find the rest. Try asking the spirits you know for help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Spirits... Oh, Monster Tree Mountain...!

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Lord Lapidem outside should be able to help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while. I should go visit him. See you later, Harmonia.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes. I'll see you somewhere new. I must go help the other spirits.
(Harmonia says goodbye and slowly walks toward the Burning City.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somewhere new...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She said she used to live elsewhere. I suppose she'll go back there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, straight to Monster Tree Mountain.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Such warm weather. Makes a fellow sleepy.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Oops, can't fall asleep. Must keep my wits about me. Last time I nodded off, Arborum appeared. Terrible business.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Oh, there you are.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Lapidem. Have you been well?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Well enough. I've heard plenty about you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry I haven't visited lately.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: No trouble, no trouble. You're busy. After earning all that trust and never showing your face, I nearly forgot what you looked like.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Only joking. It's the goddess' work, after all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That sounded rather sincere just now...)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Have you been to Pneuma? Harmonia's students have been traveling about, and I heard the spirits mention it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I had something to discuss with Lady Gaia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Lapidem about your visit to Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: So the Weaver was there. I'd heard Lady Gaia took the child in.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: You want to know where the hourglasses you brought back have gone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'd like to draw on your wisdom, Lapidem.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Wisdom? I've simply lived a bit longer. Let's see. What's left...?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Prosperity and vitality. Does that mean what humans call money?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Perhaps it does?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Then there's your answer. You know the youngsters around here who are mad about money? Always running around catching cats.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, the mercenaries?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: That girl, Parmila. She comes here often, never realizing I'm a spirit, and prays. 'Dear spirit, look after our company and let us earn loads of money, please!'

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: She came by just now, too. Always takes a flower from in front of me when she leaves. Ah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Something felt odd, though I couldn't place it. Must have been the hourglass. It was probably among the flowers Parmila took.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: How badly must she want money for that object to go to a human...? She's quite something.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: What are you waiting for, %s? Get going. If that flower reaches a place where traces of evil linger, we'll have trouble.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Hurry, ask the mercenary girl and find it! Bring it straight to me when you do. Understood?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, yes! I will!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Straight to Parmila, then.)

steps.name: Colors of Emotion (6)
steps.objective: Defeat [Letum] in 「Warriors' Rest」 and obtain the <Orange Hourglass>. Then turn in the quest to [Lapidem] in 「Monster Tree Mountain」.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Captain, I've mostly finished the work you assigned.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Then shall we get going? We can leave things here to Arcane for a while.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...To Glaston?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: No. There's something to do first. We need to get you out from under the council's watch, Callone.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: What are you thinking about, Callone? Our little cat passing through?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I was startled by meeting the princess and said the wrong thing. How long are you going to tease me about it?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hehe. Until you die?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Caaaptaaain...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone. Wait. Shh.
(At Parmila's gesture, Callone nods.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, both of you. It's been a while.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Have you been well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you know... Nothing unusual here?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Should there be?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, not necessarily...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: They say incidents follow wherever %s goes.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: The events we hear about alone are enough to draw the empire's attention.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not some detective. It's not that bad.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: A joke. Just a joke. You are looking for something, though, right? You keep glancing around.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did you put the flower you brought from Monster Tree Mountain?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: A flower? Oh, that one? It looked pretty, so I brought it back carefully. Was I not supposed to?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not that. I need it.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Really? I prayed for lots of money before taking it, but I suppose it can't be helped. I left it in the middle of the Belkia Kingdom Army Cemetery.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Parmila!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Must be urgent. Does it really call for running that fast?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: We belong to different worlds, after all. Directly involved with the gods...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, what's wrong with us? Have a little confidence.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Now we'll track down the people the council is watching—the ones hiding in Freios. That should reveal what the Magic Bureau is concealing.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...Will that be all right?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes. There's someone I need to meet sooner or later anyway.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...Someone on Her Majesty's side?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Perhaps. Or a wi... Oops. I'll tell you later. Let's pack first.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Understood...
(Orange light spills from among the vast number of flowers, as numerous as the headstones in the Warriors' Resting Place.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, here it is! The orange hourglass...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm glad it appeared, but why did it reveal itself here?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thinking won't give me an answer. Let's just return to Monster Tree Mountain.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: That sky looks unusual. Different from any I've seen before... Oh, you're back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I found it and brought it straight here. What were you saying to yourself?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Something feels strange... Maybe because so many spirits have come out of hiding, but...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: (This isn't like the feeling of meeting an Agasura, either...)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Anyway...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Oh? You've brought the hourglass intact? I thought it had seeped into the flower. Never mind. Put it in front of me. It'll disappear on its own.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Here...
(You set down the hourglass as Lapidem instructed. As you wait, the surrounding flowers bloom and fade over and over.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it vanished without a trace.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: That's a relief, at least.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: But that hourglass... I can't tell whether it sought out something to receive its prosperity and vitality, or someone changed it.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Imagine if that power had entered a grave. There may be little left of those Belkia soldiers but bones, but having them roam Mirgandia would be a nuisance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's true.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. Retrieving them isn't difficult, but there are quite a few.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Can't be helped. It's your job now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where should I look for the rest?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Hmm... Try another spirit you know.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Passion and love, happiness, hope and peace, and care for another. Four left, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. The only other spirit I can reach right away is Narin.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Ah, Narin. Narin! The Spirit King of Water and Ice, yes? She'll be waiting for you. Go on, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know Narin will be waiting for me?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I'm a spirit, and you're human, aren't you? Spirits have our own ways of understanding one another.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose you do.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Then hurry along to Narin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go right away. And I'm sorry. I'll visit more often.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Still taking my little remark to heart? Forget it. It's all right. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If Narin is waiting, which hourglass is there...? I'd better go.)

steps.name: Colors of Emotion (8)
steps.objective: Defeat [Liriope] in 「Echo Spring」 and obtain the <Indigo Hourglass>. Then turn in the quest to [Narin] in 「Gerda」.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Welcome, %s!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I have been waiting for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you knew I was coming.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: The spirits were unsettled, so I investigated with what little ability I possess. I learned that an object from another world had fallen nearby.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Its energy resembled mine, and I sensed Lady Gaia's touch, so I was watching it for the time being.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Then an elder spirit sent word from afar. That is why I awaited you, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Would you tell me about the place you visited?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Narin about your visit to Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It fills me with a strange longing...
(As Narin speaks, tears gather in her eyes and fall. They become ice crystals, carried away on the wind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narin?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Forgive me. I did not mean to... I simply felt someone's wish to offer comfort. Ah!

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It seems to be outside the village. The object lies where great power once lingered...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Great power outside the village...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Echo Spring, surely. Since the object entered this world with you, Adventurer, it will probably reveal itself only to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll find it and bring it straight back to you.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I shall await you gladly.
(Narin gazes intently at the hourglass received from %s.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: This indigo hourglass...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: ...Emotions surge within it. For the sake of life... Perhaps the nature of a living being that puts others before itself.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: They are connected to the feelings once held by the ancient gods.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: If the power of this hourglass reaches the goddess, it will help her greatly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I am merely doing my duty. Pardon me. I shall deal with it as swiftly as melting ice in an instant.
(Narin opens her scroll and sets the indigo hourglass upon it.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Narin, Narin, Nariring!
(As Narin chants, the hourglass slowly seeps into the scroll like powder.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never get used to that spell, no matter how often I hear it.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: You must hear it a thousand more times. Then you will grow accustomed to it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Does it really take that many?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hehe. That is all for today. I believe these feelings will be of great help to the goddess.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: This scroll was bestowed by a god...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Narin. I've collected quite a few with the spirits' help. But I have no idea where to look for the rest.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Lady Iris must be considering how to find them as well. You will still need the spirits' help.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Which spirits perform which duties... I shall help you learn.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris must have a lot to think about too...)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Do not worry too much. Io and I will look into the hourglasses' whereabouts in various ways. Please wait for word.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It is no trouble. Now, I have duties to attend to, so I shall take my leave.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't have a clear lead, but all I can do is keep gathering clues...)

translation.method: Fresh translation from the current Korean source
